limits: Every arm starts fresh: only saved lifestyle and official60 responses; all prior field, profession, facet and history answers withheld.

Research 0.97 adds only source-cited legacy profile facts to the frozen 0.96 resolver; it preserves the reviewed dispatch repairs while preserving existing 0.93 answers and current 0.90 evidence thresholds; no latent profile facts, demographics, education preferences or future answers in targeting.
A budget is a maximum; stop when no eligible unanswered question remains. Unknown answers count toward burden and never become positive or negative interests.
All 172 legacy profiles were source-reviewed into a separate structured overlay. Sparse or unmeasured interests remain unknown; reviewed does not imply complete preferences.
Fixed holdout splits reported separately; previous results informed development and are not unseen validation.
All published checkpoints checked against the canonical engine. Synthetic replay measures implementation coverage, not observed student outcomes.

Checkpoint-stop is a separate prefix-only policy: at each tested count, stop once a supported Top and any supported college/graduate option coexist. It never unions different states or grants evidence.
Legacy facts are manually source-coded, not independently validated student responses. The live question wording and official 60-item assessment are unchanged.
Repairs can change which questions are selected within a fixed budget. More supported Top matches do not guarantee more college Top matches; compare each budget explicitly.
Question counts measure items, not completion time; multi-select items may take longer than Likert items.
College/graduate Top means a bachelor’s or graduate route under the shared education taxonomy; associate/certificate routes remain separate. Top is capped at three careers per model.
Repairs are limited to reviewed exact question IDs, unchanged prompt and career scope. All previously valid answers and review holds are preserved; a missing specialty is not inferred.

Comparator is frozen 0.96 fresh-start targeting. Only legacy profile facts are added; every model starts fresh. Other profiles, questions, selection policy and support thresholds are unchanged. Unknowns remain unknown.
